profile.name: Yawei WU
profile.heroDescription: Exploring how rocks deform and what they reveal about subduction interfaces.

about: I investigate the connection between the structures we see in rocks and the physical processes operating deep within the Earth.

My research brings together field structural geology, metamorphic petrology, microstructural analysis and rock rheology. Working on exhumed high-pressure rocks from the North Qilian paleo-subduction interface, I explore how contrasting rock types accommodate stress and strain—and how these records may illuminate transient coupling and deep slow slip.

My doctoral research was jointly supervised at Peking University and the Chinese Academy of Geological Sciences. A CSC-funded research exchange in Lyon expanded this work through international collaboration. My next research direction connects natural rock records with high-pressure, high-temperature deformation experiments.
